diagnostics.message: The iam_project_id output is intended to wait for IAM bindings, but it does not depend on google_project_iam_member.additive. Its source instead names the nonexistent google_project_iam_member.non_authoritative. Replace that stale dependency with google_project_iam_member.additive so consumers wait for the additive grants too.

google_project_iam_binding.authoritative receives role names through var.iam_roles without depending on google_project_iam_custom_role.roles. When those names identify custom roles created here, bindings can be applied before the roles exist or roles deleted before their bindings. Resolve matching names through the custom-role resources to establish ordering.

fix.expression: lookup({ for r in google_project_iam_custom_role.roles : r.name => r.name }, each.value, each.value)

diagnostics.message: google_project_iam_member.additive receives role names through its input-derived map without depending on google_project_iam_custom_role.roles. When an additive grant uses a custom role created here, Terraform can create the grant before that role exists or delete the role before removing the grant. Resolve matching names through the custom-role resources.

fix.expression: lookup({ for r in google_project_iam_custom_role.roles : r.name => r.name }, each.value.role, each.value.role)
